create_confidence_sampler: create a DensePoseConfidenceBasedSampler instance with sigma_2 confidence channel and 8 samples per class
produce_index_sample: produce a sample of indices from a tensor by sorting confidence values and selecting top candidates
produce_labels_and_results: produce DensePose segmentation labels and UV results stacked with confidence channel from a predictor instance
configure_search_multiplier: configure the sampler with a search_count_multiplier to limit candidates to a multiple of count_per_class
configure_search_proportion: configure the sampler with a search_proportion to consider a fraction of total estimates as candidates
